title: Official PO Short Code Management
subtitle: Registers the 3-character Supplier/Brand abbreviation used for Official PO No. auto-numbering (BR-08). This records the value Gulliver has already decided - G-OPS never generates one itself.

field.businessCodeHelp: Enter an existing Supplier Code or Brand Code.
field.shortCodeHelp: Enter the 3-character abbreviation Gulliver has decided, exactly as given.

error.INVALID_OFFICIAL_PO_SHORT_CODE: Type must be Supplier or Brand, and Short Code must be exactly 3 characters.
error.SUPPLIER_CODE_NOT_FOUND: Code was not found as a Supplier in G-SYS.
error.BRAND_CODE_NOT_FOUND: Code was not found as a Brand in G-SYS.
error.DUPLICATE_OFFICIAL_PO_SHORT_CODE: An active Short Code already exists for this Type/Code.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
